description.value: Hello Nori is a Japanese hand roll bar specializing in Temaki made to order with crispy premium nori, warm seasoned rice, and Ocean Wise-certified sustainable seafood sourced from local Vancouver suppliers. The Robson Street location features a Japanese-inspired interior with sake served in cedar 'Masu' boxes beneath cascading wooden wave ceiling installations. A dedicated to-go menu and delivery partnerships via Uber Eats and DoorDash make it a practical quick-stop for cyclists who want quality Japanese cuisine without a long sit-down.
